episodes.question: Why does an isolated, small soap bubble tend to round out after leaving the wand?
invariants: Compare equal enclosed volume in 3D; k longer axis and 1/sqrt(k) on both other axes. Shape changes are schematic and not measured timing.
Surface tension acts along film, not as independent radial arrows; show short tangential paired pulls or surface-area decrease only.
Bubble free of wand after detaching; no foam clusters or claims all bubbles are perfectly spherical.
episodes.simplification: Assume isolated small bubble in still air. Ignore wind, gravity deformation, film drainage and pressure evolution during detachment. Compare a fixed idealized trapped-air volume; actual bubbles can have small volume/pressure changes and loss over time.
episodes.description_en: A small free soap bubble is a thin liquid film around air. Surface tension favors less surface area, and for a given enclosed volume a sphere has the least surface area.
episodes.description_zh: 泡泡棒能固定液膜的形狀，自由漂浮的泡泡則會自己變圓。

sources.evidence: Explanation of why free bubbles form spheres and why frames constrain soap films.
Soap bubble formation: surface energy and why the sphere minimizes surface for a fixed volume.

claims.text: A small free soap bubble is a thin liquid film around air. Surface tension favors less surface area, and for a given enclosed volume a sphere has the least surface area.

cues.en: This bubble leaves the wand stretched like an egg. What makes it turn round?
cues.zh: 這顆泡泡離開泡泡棒時拉得像一顆蛋。是什麼讓它變圓？
cues.visual: Close-up: the same stretched bubble detaches, wobbles, and rounds out. Hold a brief before/after silhouette side by side.

cues.en: A soap bubble is a thin liquid film wrapped around a pocket of air.
cues.zh: 肥皂泡是一層薄薄的液膜，包住一團空氣。
cues.visual: Cut to a cross section of a detached bubble with distinct boundary and air interior. Magnify the film near one edge.

cues.en: Making more film surface takes energy. Surface tension pulls along the film and tends to shrink its area.
cues.zh: 增加液膜的表面積需要能量。表面張力沿著液膜拉，讓表面積傾向縮小。
cues.visual: Show restrained tangential pulls along opposite edges of a highlighted film patch. Then lift away schematic arrows.

cues.en: Imagine a stretched bubble and a round one holding the same volume of trapped air.
cues.zh: 想像一顆拉長的泡泡和一顆圓泡泡，裡面包住的空氣體積一樣大。
cues.visual: Side-by-side 3D ellipsoid and sphere. Set stretched shape axes k, 1/sqrt(k), 1/sqrt(k) times sphere radius. Equal-volume labels apply to the 3D shapes.

cues.en: The stretched one needs more film area. A sphere needs the least area for that volume.
cues.zh: 拉長的泡泡需要更多液膜。相同體積下，球體需要的表面積最小。
cues.visual: Label the two outer surfaces, then show matched-scale qualitative bars labelled Film area, longer for ellipsoid. Preserve identical enclosed volume.
cues.overlay_en: More film area / Less film area

cues.en: So a small bubble floating free tends to settle into the round shape.
cues.zh: 所以，小泡泡自由漂浮時，形狀會漸漸接近球體。
cues.visual: Animate free small bubble from stretched to round with damped wobble; preserve qualitative volume in this morph.

cues.en: The air still has room inside. The round film just wraps it with less surface.
cues.zh: 裡面的空氣還有原來那麼多空間，圓圓的液膜只用了更少的表面積。
cues.visual: Return to side-by-side moment snapshots of isolated bubble; retain the equal-volume callout and smaller surface bar so final comparison refers to idealized illustration.

episodes.title_en: What Makes a Compass Needle Turn?
episodes.title_zh: 指南針的指針是被什麼轉動的？
episodes.question: What causes a freely pivoting compass needle to point near north?
invariants: Fixed overhead camera and unchanged field arrows while the housing turns 90° in the hook/return. Separately show the needle rotating back toward the field when perturbed.
Clearly distinguish geographic map north arrow from local magnetic bearing; no assertion that the needle aims at a single exact point.
Mark tilt restricted by ordinary flat compass, so arrows represent horizontal component.
episodes.simplification: Work with a level compass and a stable local field away from interfering metal or magnets; shown declination exaggerated.
episodes.description_en: A compass needle is a small magnet that pivots to align with the horizontal component of the local magnetic field; Earth’s field normally dominates, but its heading can differ from true north.
episodes.description_zh: 再轉一下外殼。底下的外殼在轉，指針還是跟著磁場方向。

sources.evidence: Needle is a freely pivoting magnet, turns in local or Earth magnetic field, and can have interference.

sources.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.evidence: Compass FAQ explains local horizontal field direction and magnetic declination from true north.

claims.text: A compass needle is a small magnet that pivots to align with the horizontal component of the local magnetic field; Earth’s field normally dominates, but its heading can differ from true north.

cues.en: Turn the case a quarter turn. Why does the compass needle keep pointing the same way?
cues.zh: 把指南針的外殼轉四分之一圈。為什麼指針還是指著同一個方向？
cues.visual: Use a fixed overhead camera with a stationary trail map below the compass. Rotate only the housing by 90 degrees. Use a fixed marker on the map to make the needle's retained direction obvious.

cues.en: The needle is a little magnet balanced on a pivot. It can turn inside the case.
cues.zh: 指針是一根架在支點上的小磁鐵，能在外殼裡轉動。
cues.visual: Explode the compass layering into case, pivot and colored needle. Then collapse back to fixed overhead view.

cues.en: Earth has a magnetic field. At your location, part of that field runs along the ground.
cues.zh: 地球有磁場。在你所在的位置，磁場有一部分是沿著水平面的。
cues.visual: Briefly tilt viewpoint to show tilted field vector and horizontal projection separately, then return to the overhead schematic.

cues.en: The field turns the needle until it lines up with that horizontal direction.
cues.zh: 磁場讓指針轉動，直到指針與磁場的水平方向一致。
cues.visual: Show lightly perturbed needle rotating toward fixed horizontal field arrow. Case does not move in this shot.

cues.en: The marked tip gives the magnetic heading. The map’s true north can point a different way.
cues.zh: 標記的那端指出當地磁北的方向，和地圖的正北方向可能不同。
cues.visual: Show one map north arrow and one local magnetic heading arrow separated by a clear illustrative angle. Keep the needle aligned with the local field arrow.

cues.en: Watch the case again. The markings move, but the field direction stays the same.
cues.zh: 再看一次外殼。外殼上的刻度轉了，但磁場方向沒變。
cues.visual: Replay the initial housing rotation against the same stationary background and fixed field arrow.

cues.en: And that’s why the needle still points the same way.
cues.zh: 所以，指針還是指著同一個方向。
cues.visual: Hold the now-rotated case with the marked needle pointing at the same stationary map dot from the opening.
